assets.title: Supported Fire Hose Reel
assets.description: Original static firefighting hose reel with twin thick six-spoke open side plates, a broad winding core, a fixed shaft, two visible outboard bearing stands and connected flat ground feet. One continuous closed hose mesh follows six separated gradually expanding turns, then a smooth outlet route into a parked downward nozzle. A grounded frame arm and a bored retaining collar support the nozzle; its annular tip has a genuine blind opening, and a short rear inlet coupling has a real recessed bore. Five solid PBR materials, separate named editable parts, source Z up, metres and ground-centre origin. One reusable prop, no scene, textures or external dependencies. Distinct from the existing two-extinguisher cabinet, unspooled fishing reel and flat harbor rope. Only one checked static pose: no winding or deployment animation, fluid, pressure, plumbing compatibility, fire suppression performance, real operation, installation or fire-safety certification.
